title: earthcore-engine: a partition-closed light-element model of Earth's core
description:
Reproducibility package for a thermodynamic accounting of the light elements in Earth's core. A sourced Mie-Grueneisen-Debye equation-of-state ledger builds a multiphase iron-alloy aggregate (hexagonal iron, B2 FeSi, metallic FeO, Fe7C3, Fe3S and nickel), evaluated with BurnMan and closed against the Preliminary Reference Earth Model (PREM) by a chemical-potential balance across the inner-core boundary. The core directory holds the ledgers, the four-element search, the sensitivity scenarios, the Monte Carlo, the checks, the result tables, the figure scripts and a walkthrough notebook that recomputes the best fit. The qha_campaign directory holds the first-principles quasiharmonic equation-of-state campaign for the solid endmembers (Quantum ESPRESSO, PBE, finite-displacement phonons): settings, per-phase free-energy tables, and the equation-of-state fit.
